init_franka_robot: create a FrankaRobot instance by passing urdf_path and sim to the constructor
get_franka_params: call _get_franka_params on a FrankaRobot to retrieve its StaticManipulatorParams configuration
configure_arm_joints: customize the 7 arm joint indices via the arm_joints parameter in StaticManipulatorParams
configure_gripper_state: set gripper open and closed states using gripper_open_state and gripper_closed_state arrays
configure_motor_gains: tune arm motor behavior by adjusting arm_mtr_pos_gain, arm_mtr_vel_gain, and arm_mtr_max_impulse
